clues: This is the biggest town on the Olympic Peninsula in Washington. It is the seat of its county, too.
The Olympic Mountains block much of the rain bound for this city. So it stays far drier than the land just west of the range.
In 1791, a Spanish explorer gave the harbor here a long Spanish name. Later, English speakers cut that long name down to size.
John Elway was born in this town. He is a hall of fame star of football.
The MV Coho is the town's famed ferry boat. It sails across the Strait of Juan de Fuca to Victoria, Canada.
